changelog:
Initial release of Zhuanzhuan Recycle Estimator skill:

- Supports valuation for a wide range of products (phones, tablets, laptops, home appliances, more) based on user text and/or images.
- Guides users to provide key details (model, capacity, condition, etc.) for accurate price estimates via natural follow-up questions.
- Prioritizes delivering professional, specific valuation responses and gently directs users to Zhuanzhuan for final transactions.
- Structured handling of clarifications and options selection for multi-turn conversations.
- Ensures concise, expert tone and hides internal implementation details from users.
